purpose: Evidence discovery for future memory prerequisites, not a new training or evaluation dataset
source_type: Agent trajectories on real repositories with synthetic defects; not human-authored natural issues
review_order: Increasing parquet row and tool-call message index; at most the first 20 candidate records for detailed initial review
grouping: Same repository and upstream revision remains one connected source family even when defect or trajectory IDs differ
exclusion_review: Application bug or deliberately failing assertion rather than execution prerequisite
Repair depends on an intervening source edit not a reusable environment procedure
preserve: Subsequent tool commands and intervening edit metadata
Source row/message IDs, pinned revision and raw-message digest
future_use: Evidence card candidates only. A separate target state, predecision observation protocol, split graph, and paired worker outcomes are required before utility supervision.
